## KeyMetadataUpdate interface

The fields of a stored key record that may change after the key is issued.

Only the display name. A key's permissions and expiry are carried by its signed token and fixed when it is issued; the stored record is the receipt of that grant, so the grant cannot be edited. To narrow what a key may do, set its policy with [setKeyPolicy()](./runtime.setkeypolicy.md)<!-- -->. To change its grant, revoke it with [revokeKey()](./runtime.revokekey.md) and issue a new one.

Every other `ApiKeyMetadata` field is declared as `never`<!-- -->, derived from `ApiKeyMetadata` itself, so a value that carries one is a type error even when it is not a fresh object literal (a variable holding `{ name, permissions }`<!-- -->, or a `Partial<ApiKeyMetadata>`<!-- -->), and a field added to `ApiKeyMetadata` later is refused the same way.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface KeyMetadataUpdate extends Readonly<Partial<Record<Exclude<keyof ApiKeyMetadata, 'name'>, never>>>
```

**Extends:** Readonly&lt;Partial&lt;Record&lt;Exclude&lt;keyof [ApiKeyMetadata](./core.apikeymetadata.md)<!-- -->, 'name'&gt;, never&gt;&gt;&gt;
